workflows.expectedStateAudio: Barr reference is visible; conservative Trigger Impulse or loaded audio reaches the selected graph without hidden mutation.
workflows.saveReopen: Factory identity and complete graph round-trip through patch and host state.
workflows.undoRedo: Audition transport remains outside graph history.
workflows.accessibility: Named source, transport, Wet/Dry, mute, and status controls remain keyboard reachable.
workflows.realTimeSafety: Prepared source routing and final-output safety are bounded on the callback.
workflows.failureRecovery: Missing device/file reports an actionable status without changing the graph.

workflows.expectedStateAudio: Typed primitive creation and explicit Sum insertion publish only a valid connected graph.
workflows.saveReopen: Schema-v2 preserves semantic graph, layout, stable IDs, and millisecond parameters.
workflows.undoRedo: Creation, connection, and assisted Sum are single reversible history operations.
workflows.accessibility: Palette click, keyboard, touch-sized targets, and drag-to-canvas use the same creation path.
workflows.realTimeSafety: Compilation remains worker-owned and publication is bounded.
workflows.failureRecovery: Illegal algebraic cycles retain the last valid runtime and expose the failing path.

workflows.expectedStateAudio: The Matrix parent opens to its authoritative 16 Gains, 12 Sums, and crossing cables without changing audio truth.
workflows.saveReopen: Parent presentation, proxy ports, child membership, and nested viewport round-trip.
workflows.undoRedo: Parent and nested canvases share one graph history.
workflows.accessibility: Breadcrumbs, Back, parent focus, and compact navigation are named and keyboard operable.
workflows.realTimeSafety: Expansion is presentation-only; the prepared primitive runtime is unchanged.
workflows.failureRecovery: Invalid compound metadata falls back to authoritative primitives.

workflows.expectedStateAudio: Inspector, schematic, Macro, and tuning layers reflect the active revision and audible value.
workflows.saveReopen: Committed parameters and quality policy persist; temporary preview layers do not.
workflows.undoRedo: Cumulative tuning commits as a conflict-aware transaction and restores the exact prior value.
workflows.accessibility: Advanced disclosure and value/status text do not rely on color.
workflows.realTimeSafety: Control ramps and topology publication remain bounded and lock-free at block entry.
workflows.failureRecovery: Superseded or rejected revisions cannot overwrite newer visible controls.

workflows.expectedStateAudio: Isolate, mute, legal bypass, and raw or impulse-matched A/B affect audition only until explicitly promoted.
workflows.saveReopen: Preview overlays and A/B snapshots are excluded from patch and host persistence.
workflows.undoRedo: Promotion/revert creates explicit graph history; switching does not.
workflows.accessibility: State, latency, probe validity, and exit commands are textually disclosed.
workflows.realTimeSafety: Preview publication uses the existing compiled crossfade and refuses unsafe bypass.
workflows.failureRecovery: Global exits clear temporary layers without clearing safety latches.

workflows.expectedStateAudio: WAV, AIFF, or FLAC playback uses explicit channel policy; export renders the chosen source range and bounded tail once.
workflows.saveReopen: Transport, source paths, and export state remain private and non-persistent.
workflows.undoRedo: Transport and export never enter graph history.
workflows.accessibility: Load, waveform, loop, playback, mode, progress, and cancel remain named in the standalone drawer.
workflows.realTimeSafety: Decode/read-ahead/export are worker-owned; callback reads are bounded.
workflows.failureRecovery: Cancel is atomic; unsafe destination, Emergency Mute, or safety latch refuses export.

workflows.expectedStateAudio: Align, distribute, bounded group arrangement, cable routes, and orientation change presentation only.
workflows.saveReopen: Routes, group bounds, hierarchy, orientation, and viewports persist without semantic hash drift.
workflows.undoRedo: Each accepted layout operation is one reversible edit; impossible layouts are no-ops.
workflows.accessibility: Commands expose names, disabled states, and current focus at desktop and minimum size.
workflows.realTimeSafety: No DSP compile occurs for presentation-only changes.
workflows.failureRecovery: Protected-neighbor overlap and insufficient spans are refused with stable selection/context.

workflows.expectedStateAudio: An abnormal standalone exit offers the exact last-known-valid candidate and restores it only in an Emergency-Muted state.
workflows.saveReopen: Autosave accepts only normally validated graph JSON and never overwrites a patch or VST3 host project.
workflows.undoRedo: Recovery establishes a new base history rather than fabricating edits.
workflows.accessibility: Restore muted, Start clean, Open reports, candidate hash, and incident ID are screen-reader visible at minimum size.
workflows.realTimeSafety: The exception boundary signals a pre-created non-audio worker; no crash I/O occurs in the callback.
workflows.failureRecovery: Two abnormal recovery attempts quarantine the candidate; decline retains reports.

workflows.expectedStateAudio: Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+M always latches final output silent and never toggles on repeat.
workflows.saveReopen: The explicit manual latch uses host state; recovery activates it before publishing recovered audio.
workflows.undoRedo: Graph history cannot clear manual mute or the numerical-safety latch.
workflows.accessibility: Shortcut, native button, Help command, diagnostics, and assertive announcement expose one state.
workflows.realTimeSafety: The authoritative atomic latch is checked at final output.
workflows.failureRecovery: Active mute cancels/refuses export; Reset Safety remains a separate explicit action.

workflows.expectedStateAudio: Searchable offline Help explains audible purpose, signal behavior, safety, workflows, and evidence without changing the graph or audio.
workflows.saveReopen: Opening and closing Help preserves graph, selection, viewport, history, and audible state.
workflows.undoRedo: Help navigation never enters graph history.
workflows.accessibility: Articles, search, results, context links, and return focus work at desktop and minimum size.
workflows.realTimeSafety: Help rendering and report-folder access stay off the audio callback.
workflows.failureRecovery: Shipped guidance covers safe startup, recovery choices, local report privacy, and issue details.
